abilities.desc_zh: 远程重火器发射高温热核弹，击中必定引发燃烧 (Burn)，持续造成火热伤害并阻止敌方任何生命恢复。
abilities.desc_en: Fires thermonuclear incendiary rounds, inflicting Burn that deals continuous damage and completely nullifies enemy Healing/Regen.

abilities.desc_zh: 连击计数达到 5 的倍数时，获得一层爆轰增益：使下一次重击必定暴击，并获得 35% 的暴击伤害增益。重击命中 100% 概率施加燃烧减益，造成攻击力 60% 的伤害，持续 5 秒。
abilities.desc_en: At every 5 combo hits, gains a Charge Buff: makes the next Heavy Attack guaranteed to Critically Hit with a 35% Crit Damage Buff. Heavy Attacks: 100% chance to inflict Burn dealing 60% Attack over 5s.

abilities.desc_zh: 特殊攻击暴击时，引爆目标身上所有的燃烧减益，每层燃烧立即造成攻击力 [30% - 60%] 的瞬时爆发热伤害；如果目标身上没有任何燃烧减益，则立即对其施加一层燃烧减益，造成攻击力 [50% - 100%] 的伤害，持续 5 秒。
abilities.desc_en: When a Special Attack lands a Critical Hit, detonates all active Burns on the opponent, dealing [30% - 60%] Attack as instant burst damage per stack; if the opponent has no active Burn, immediately inflicts Burn dealing [50% - 100%] Attack over 5s.

abilities.desc_zh: 每一击有 75% 概率施加燃烧减益，造成攻击力 40% 的伤害，持续 4 秒；若发生暴击，额外获得 30% 暴击伤害增益，持续 4 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Each hit has a 75% chance to inflict Burn dealing 40% Attack over 4s; Critical Hits grant a 30% Crit Damage Buff for 4s.

abilities.desc_zh: 技能激活时获得不可阻挡增益，持续至技能结束。最后一击 100% 概率施加 2 层燃烧减益，造成攻击力 80% 的伤害，持续 6 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Gains Unstoppable while the Special is active. Last hit: 100% chance to inflict 2 stacks of Burn dealing 80% Attack over 6s.

abilities.desc_zh: 最后一击 100% 概率施加 3 层燃烧减益，造成攻击力 120% 的伤害，持续 7 秒；并即时扣除对方最大能量值的 20%。
abilities.desc_en: Last hit: 100% chance to inflict 3 stacks of Burn dealing 120% Attack over 7s, and immediately drains 20% of opponent Max Power.

abilities.desc_zh: 与酸雨、离子风同队时，全队元素减益持续时间延长 {{var_1}}。
abilities.desc_en: Elemental debuffs last {{var_1}} longer when teamed with Acid Storm and Ion Storm.

abilities.desc_zh: 与电影铁皮、搅拌者同队时，暴击率提升 {{var_2}}。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_2}} Critical Rating when teamed with Ironhide or Mixmaster.

abilities.desc_zh: 团队所有低星级队员获得 +{{var_3}} 爆炸伤害。
abilities.desc_en: All lower tier teammates gain +{{var_3}} Explosive Damage.
